<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class QualifixTicket extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    protected $table = 'qualifix_tickets';

    protected $fillable = [
        'ticket_number',
        'student_id',
        'subject_id',
        'class_group_id',
        'title',
        'question',
        'status',
        'submitted_at',
        'resolved_at',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'submitted_at' => 'datetime',
        'resolved_at' => 'datetime',
    ];

    public function student()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Student::class, 'student_id');
    }

    public function classGroup()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(ClassGroup::class, 'class_group_id');
    }

    public function subject()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Subject::class, 'subject_id');
    }

    public function staff()
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(StaffProfile::class, 'qualifix_assignments', 'ticket_id', 'staff_id');
    }
}

Now my recommendation: **Opsi A, dipecah jadi 2 tahap**, dengan Stage 1 sebagai inti:

Stage 1 (Inti / MVP — "Klinik PR hidup"):
1. Siswa: form ajukan (POST /siswa/qualifix) → QualifixTicket + auto-assign tentor via schedule_rules (cocok mapel + kelas siswa) fallback ke staff aktif; lampiran opsional (File model existing).
2. Tentor: antrean + balas (POST /tentor/qualifix/{ticket}/jawab) → qualifix_answers, status jadi sedang_dibahas, tombol "Tandai Selesai" → status selesai + resolved_at.
3. Status/label konsisten (ada bug: student controller menghitung status 'dijawab' tapi tidak ada di enum).
4. Test Pest + seeder demo.

Stage 2 (Poles): admin assign manual/re-assign, rekap sesi di Laporan & Pengaturan, filter &搜 di admin, notifikasi WA.

Bug yang perlu dicatat: status 'dijawab' di StudentController tidak ada di enum DB (menunggu_tentor, sedang_dibahas, selesai) → KPI "Sudah Dijawab" selalu 0. Dan admin controller memetakan 'dibahas' → 'sedang_dibahas' ok.

Also controller admin: `->with(['student','subject','classGroup','staff'])` + N+1 concern minimal (eager loading ok). Also `$ticket->mapel = $ticket->subject?->name.' ('.$ticket->classGroup?->code.')'` — if subject null → error; subject is non-nullable though.

Also note admin blade shows ticket list; does it show answers? Not needed.

Let me present the recommendation concisely with concrete file-level plan and ask for confirmation on 3 decisions:
1. Auto-assign: via schedule_rules (mapel+kelas) dengan fallback ke staff aktif, atau manual oleh admin?
2. Nomor tiket format: KPR-YYYYMM-#### (kontinu) atau KPR-#### random?
3. Lampiran file: wajib atau opsional? (opsional lebih aman)

Confirmed: tentor page UI sudah ada (kolom jawab), student page UI sudah ada. Yang hilang murni backend-nya.

Now write the recommendation.

## Rekomendasi saya: **Opsi A, dipecah 2 tahap** — dan Tahap 1 saja yang saya kerjakan sekarang

Alasannya: seluruh UI (form ajukan siswa, panel jawab tentor, daftar & KPI admin) **sudah ada dan rapi**. Yang hilang murni bagian backend: tidak ada satu pun route tulis, dan tabelnya kosong. Jadi案中 terbaik bukan bikin ulang UI, tapi menyambungkan alur yang sudah designed itu ke database — hasilnya langsung "hidup" dengan risiko rendah.

### Tahap 1 — Inti (saya rekomendasikan dikerjakan sekarang)

Alur: **Siswa ajukan → tiket masuk antrean → tentor jawab → selesai → muncul di admin & dashboard.**

| # | Pekerjaan | File |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `POST /siswa/qualifix` + `FormRequest` (validasi mapel/judul/isi, lampiran opsional) | `routes/web.php`, `app/Http/Requests/...` |
| 2 | Generate `ticket_number` (mis. `KPR-202611-0001`, unik, urut per bulan) | service baru `QualifixService` |
| 3 | Auto-assign tentor via **`schedule_rules`** (cocok mapel + kelas siswa) → fallback staff aktif bila tidak ada | pivot `qualifix_assignments` |
| 4 | Simpan tiket + lampiran ke `files` & `qualifix_attachments` | `app/Models/File.php` (pola upload sudah ada di ManajemenMateri) |
| 5 | `POST /tentor/qualifix/{ticket}/jawab` → tulis `qualifix_answers`, status jadi `sedang_dibahas`; aksi "Tandai Selesai" → status `selesai` + isi `resolved_at` | `TentorQualifixController` |
| 6 | Modal `qualifix-ajukan-modal.blade.php` diubah dari mock → `<form>` sungguhan | blade + JS |
| 7 | Test Pest alur create → assign → jawab → selesai; + seeder demo biar halaman admin/tentor tidak kosong | `tests/Feature/...` |

**Bug yang sekalian dibenerin:** `StudentController.php:96` menghitung status `'dijawab'`, padahal enum DB cuma `menunggu_tentor | sedang_dibahas | selesai` → KPI "Sudah Dijawab" selalu 0. Satu-satunya status yang bermakna "sudah dijawab tapi belum diarsipkan" adalah `sedang_dibahas`.

### Tahap 2 — Poles (nanti, kalau alur intinya dipakai nyata)
- Admin: tombol **"Terapkan tentor"** (re-assign manual) + trauma **"Rekap Sesi Klinik PR"** di Laporan & Pengaturan yang sekarang `route => null`.

| Format nomor tiket | `KPR-YYYYMM-0001` (urut per bulan, mis. `KPR-202611-0001`) |
| Lampiran | Opsional, maks 2 file (gambar/PDF, ≤ 2MB), disimpan via `files` + `qualifix_attachments` |
| Otorisasi | Siswa hanya tiketnya sendiri; tentor hanya tiket yang di-assign ke dia; admin boleh assign/re-assign & ubah status |

### Yang akan saya kerjakan
1. **Routes** — `POST /siswa/qualifix`, `POST /tentor/qualifix/{ticket}/jawab`, `PATCH /tentor/qualifix/{ticket}/selesai`, `POST /admin/qualifix/{ticket}/tugaskan`, `PATCH /admin/qualifix/{ticket}/status`.
2. **Service baru `app/Services/QualifixService.php`** — createTicket (generate nomor unik), auto-assign, answer, resolve, reassign.
3. **Form request** — `StoreQualifixTicketRequest`, `StoreQualifixAnswerRequest` (validasi mapel/judul/isi/file).
4. **Controller** — `StudentController::storeQualifix`, `TentorQualifixController::answer|resolve`, `QualifixController::assign|updateStatus` (admin).
5. **Blade** — modal ajukan siswa jadi `<form>` sungguhan (mapel dari DB `subjects`), panel jawab tentor jadi form + tombol "Tandai Selesai", tombol admin "Tugaskan Tentor"/"Lihat Solusi" jadi aksi nyata (bukan `type="button"` mati).
6. **Bug fix** — `StudentController.php:96` status `'dijawab'` → `'sedang_dibahas'`.
7. **Test Pest** — alur lengkap: siswa ajukan → tiket masuk antrean tentor → tentor jawab → tandai selesai → tampil di admin & dashboard; plus uji otorisasi (siswa A tidak bisa lihat tiket siswa B).
8. **Seeder demo** — isi `qualifix_tickets` + `qualifix_assignments` + `qualifix_answers` supaya halaman admin/tentor/dashboard tidak kosong saat demo (seeder lama cuma 2 tiket tanpa penugatan).

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\QualifixAnswer;
use App\Models\QualifixAttachment;
use App\Models\QualifixTicket;
use App\Models\ScheduleRule;
use App\Models\StaffProfile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class QualifixService
{
    /**
     * Generate nomor tiket unik per bulan, contoh: KPR-202611-0001.
     */
    public function generateTicketNumber(): string
    {
        $prefix = 'KPR-'.now()->format('Ym');

        $last = QualifixTicket::where('ticket_number', 'like', $prefix.'-%')
            ->max('ticket_number');

        if ($last === null) {
            return $prefix.'-0001';
        }

        $seq = (int) Str::after($last, $prefix.'-') + 1;

        return $prefix.'-'.str_pad((string) $seq, 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    }

    /**
     * Buat tiket Klinik PR baru dan tetapkan tentor pendamping secara otomatis.
     *
     * @return array{ticket: QualifixTicket, staff: StaffProfile|null}
     */
    public function createTicket(array $data): array
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data) {
            $ticket = QualifixTicket::create([
                'ticket_number' => $this->generateTicketNumber(),
                'student_id' => $data['student_id'],
                'subject_id' => $data['subject_id'],
                'class_group_id' => $data['class_group_id'] ?? null,
                'title' => $data['title'],
                'question' => $data['question'],
                'status' => 'menunggu_tentor',
                'submitted_at' => now(),
            ]);

            // Lampiran pertanyaan (opsional).
            if (! empty($data['file_ids'])) {
                foreach ($data['file_ids'] as $fileId) {
                    QualifixAttachment::create([
                        'ticket_id' => $ticket->id,
                        'answer_id' => null,
                        'file_id' => $fileId,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            $staff = $this->assignTentor($ticket);

            return ['ticket' => $ticket, 'staff' => $staff];
        });
    }

    /**
     * Tetapkan tentor pendamping ke tiket berdasarkan jadwal mengajar (mapel + kelas).
     * Jika tidak ada jadwal yang cocok, gunakan tentor aktif dengan beban paling ringan.
     */
    public function assignTentor(QualifixTicket $ticket): ?StaffProfile
    {
        $candidateStaffIds = ScheduleRule::query()
            ->where('class_group_id', $ticket->class_group_id)
            ->where('subject_id', $ticket->subject_id)
            ->pluck('staff_id');

        $staff = $this->pilihTentorRingan($candidateStaffIds);

        if ($staff === null) {
            $staff = $this->pilihTentorRingan(collect());
        }

        if ($staff === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $ticket->staff()->attach($staff->id, [
            'assigned_at' => now(),
            'assigned_by' => Auth::id(),
        ]);

        return $staff;
    }

    /**
     * Ganti / tetapkan ulang tentor pendamping (aksi admin).
     */
    public function reassign(QualifixTicket $ticket, int $staffId): void
    {
        $ticket->staff()->detach();
        $ticket->staff()->attach($staffId, [
            'assigned_at' => now(),
            'assigned_by' => Auth::id(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Balas pertanyaan siswa (tentor). Status tiket menjadi sedang_dibahas.
     *
     * @return array{answer: QualifixAnswer, attachments: QualifixAttachment[]}
     */
    public function answer(QualifixTicket $ticket, array $data): array
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($ticket, $data) {
            $ticket->update(['status' => 'sedang_dibahas']);

            $answer = QualifixAnswer::create([
                'ticket_id' => $ticket->id,
                'staff_id' => Auth::user()->staff_profile_id ?? $this->staffIdFromUser(),
                'body' => $data['body'],
                'status' => 'terkirim',
                'sent_at' => now(),
            ]);

            if (! empty($data['file_ids'])) {
                foreach ($data['file_ids'] as $fileId) {
                    QualifixAttachment::create([
                        'ticket_id' => $ticket->id,
                        'answer_id' => $answer->id,
                        'file_id' => $fileId,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            return ['answer' => $answer, 'attachments' => $answer->attachments];
        });
    }

    /**
     * Tandai tiket selesai (tentor atau admin).
     */
    public function resolve(QualifixTicket $ticket): void
    {
        $ticket->update([
            'status' => 'selesai',
            'resolved_at' => now(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Perbarui status tiket (admin).
     */
    public function updateStatus(QualifixTicket $ticket, string $status): void
    {
        $attributes = ['status' => $status];

        if ($status === 'selesai') {
            $attributes['resolved_at'] = now();
        } elseif ($status !== 'selesai' && $ticket->status === 'selesai') {
            $attributes['resolved_at'] = null;
        }

        $ticket->update($attributes);
    }

    /**
     * Pilih tentor aktif dengan beban tiket non-selesai paling ringan.
     *
     * @param \Illuminate\Support\Collection<int> $staffIds
     */
    private function pilihTentorRingan(Collection $staffIds): ?StaffProfile
    {
        $query = StaffProfile::active()
            ->withCount(['qualificTickets as beban' => function ($q) {
                $q->where('status', '!=', 'selesai');
            }])
            ->orderBy('beban')
            ->orderBy('full_name_with_title');

        if ($staffIds->isNotEmpty()) {
            $query->whereIn('id', $staffIds);
        }

        return $query->first();
    }

    private function staffIdFromUser(): int
    {
        return Auth::user()->staff_profile_id
            ?? StaffProfile::where('user_id', Auth::id())->value('id')
            ?? 0;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Tentor;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\StoreQualifixAnswerRequest;
use App\Models\QualifixTicket;
use App\Services\QualifixService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\RedirectResponse;

class TentorQualifixController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly TentorQualifixService $service,
        private readonly QualifixService $qualifixService,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Tampilkan halaman Qualix (Klinik PR) tentor: antrean pertanyaan siswa dan ruang solusi.
     * Semua data diambil dari basis data (QualifixTicket yang ditugaskan kepada tentor ini).
     */
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        return view('tentor.qualifix', $this->service->qualifix($user));
    }

    /**
     * Balas pertanyaan siswa (Kirim Jawaban ke Siswa).
     */
    public function answer(QualifixTicket $ticket, StoreQualifixAnswerRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        abort_unless($ticket->staff()->where('staff_profiles.id', $this->staffId())->exists(), 403,
            'Tiket ini tidak ditugaskan kepada Anda.');

        $this->qualifixService->answer($ticket, array_merge($request->validated(), [
            'file_ids' => $this->unggahLampiran($request->file('files') ?? []),
        ]));

        return redirect()->route('tentor.qualifix')
            ->with('sukses', 'Jawaban telah dikirim ke siswa.');
    }

    /**
     * Tandai tiket selesai.
     */
    public function resolve(QualifixTicket $ticket): RedirectResponse
    {
        abort_unless($ticket->staff()->where('staff_profiles.id', $this->staffId())->exists(), 403,
            'Tiket ini tidak ditugaskan kepada Anda.');

        $this->qualifixService->resolve($ticket);

        return redirect()->route('tentor.qualifix')
            ->with('sukses', 'Tiket Klinik PR ditandai selesai.');
    }

    private function staffId(): int
    {
        return \App\Models\StaffProfile::where('user_id', auth()->id())->value('id') ?? 0;
    }

    /**
     * Unggah lampiran jawaban dan catat ke tabel files.
     *
     * @return array<int>
     */
    private function unggahLampiran(array $berkas): array
    {
        $ids = [];

        foreach ($berkas as $file) {
            $path = $file->store('qualifix', 'local');

            $ids[] = \App\Models\File::create([
                'original_name' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                'path' => $path,
                'mime_type' => $file->getMimeType(),
                'size_bytes' => $file->getSize(),
                'uploaded_by' => auth()->id(),
            ])->id;
        }

        return $ids;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\QualifixTicket;
use App\Models\StaffProfile;
use App\Services\QualifixService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\RedirectResponse;

class QualifixController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(private readonly QualifixService $qualifixService) {}

    /**
     * Tampilkan daftar tiket Klinik PR (QualiFix) yang diambil dari database.
     */
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $filters = [
            'q' => trim((string) $request->query('q', '')),
            'status' => $request->query('status', 'semua'), // semua | menunggu | dibahas | selesai
        ];

        $dbStatus = [
            'menunggu' => 'menunggu_tentor',
            'dibahas' => 'sedang_dibahas',
            'selesai' => 'selesai',
        ];

        $tiket = QualifixTicket::query()
            ->with(['student', 'subject', 'classGroup', 'staff'])
            ->when($filters['q'] !== '', function ($query) use ($filters) {
                $keyword = '%'.$filters['q'].'%';
                $query->where(function ($inner) use ($keyword) {
                    $inner->where('ticket_number', 'like', $keyword)
                        ->orWhere('title', 'like', $keyword)
                        ->orWhereHas('student', fn ($s) => $s->where('full_name', 'like', $keyword))
                        ->orWhereHas('subject', fn ($s) => $s->where('name', 'like', $keyword));
                });
            })
            ->when($filters['status'] !== 'semua', fn ($query) => $query->where('status', $dbStatus[$filters['status']] ?? $filters['status']))
            ->orderByDesc('submitted_at')
            ->orderByDesc('ticket_number')
            ->paginate(10)
            ->withQueryString();

        $dbToView = array_flip($dbStatus);

        $tiket->getCollection()->each(function ($ticket) use ($dbToView): void {
            $ticket->view_status = $dbToView[$ticket->status] ?? $ticket->status;
            $ticket->mapel = $ticket->subject?->name.' ('.$ticket->classGroup?->code.')';
            $ticket->tentor_nama = $ticket->staff->first()?->full_name_with_title ?? null;
        });

        // Angka pokok antrean Klinik PR.
        $kpis = [
            'total' => QualifixTicket::count(),
            'menunggu' => QualifixTicket::where('status', 'menunggu_tentor')->count(),
            'selesai' => QualifixTicket::where('status', 'selesai')->count(),
        ];

        // Ketersediaan tentor pendamping Klinik PR.
        $tentor = StaffProfile::active()
            ->with(['qualificTickets' => fn ($query) => $query->where('status', '!=', 'selesai')])
            ->orderBy('full_name_with_title')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn ($staff) => [
                'nama' => $staff->full_name_with_title,
                'bidang' => $staff->job_title ?? '-',
                'kondisi' => $staff->qualificTickets->isNotEmpty() ? 'membimbing' : 'tersedia',
            ])
            ->values()
            ->all();

        return view('admin.qualifix', [
            'tiket' => $tiket,
            'tentor' => $tentor,
            'filters' => $filters,
            'kpis' => $kpis,
            'per_halaman' => 10,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Tetapkan / ganti tentor pendamping untuk sebuah tiket.
     */
    public function assign(QualifixTicket $ticket, Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'staff_id' => ['required', 'exists:staff_profiles,id'],
        ]);

        $this->qualifixService->reassign($ticket, (int) $request->input('staff_id'));

        return redirect()->route('admin.qualifix')
            ->with('sukses', 'Tentor pendamping untuk tiket #'.$ticket->ticket_number.' telah diperbarui.');
    }

    /**
     * Perbarui status tiket (admin).
     */
    public function updateStatus(QualifixTicket $ticket, Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'status' => ['required', 'in:menunggu_tentor,sedang_dibahas,selesai'],
        ]);

        $this->qualifixService->updateStatus($ticket, $request->input('status'));

        return redirect()->route('admin.qualifix')
            ->with('sukses', 'Status tiket #'.$ticket->ticket_number.' diperbarui.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

class Student extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, SoftDeletes;

    protected $table = 'students';

    protected $fillable = [
        'user_id',
        'nis',
        'nisn',
        'full_name',
        'nickname',
        'birth_place',
        'birth_date',
        'email',
        'phone_wa',
        'group_wa',
        'study_shift_id',
        'address',
        'school_name',
        'school_grade',
        'education_level',
        'curriculum',
        'major',
        'photo_file_id',
        'status',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'birth_date' => 'date',
        'photo_file_id' => 'integer',
        'study_shift_id' => 'integer',
    ];

    public function user()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'user_id');
    }

    public function guardians()
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(Guardian::class, 'student_guardians', 'student_id', 'guardian_id')
            ->withPivot('relationship', 'is_primary_contact', 'is_financial_responsible')
            ->withTimestamps();
    }

    public function invoices()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Invoice::class);
    }

    public function enrollments()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Enrollment::class);
    }

    public function studyShift()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(StudyShift::class, 'study_shift_id');
    }

    public function scopeActive($query)
    {
        return $query->where('status', 'aktif');
    }

    /**
     * Dapatkan inisial nama siswa (huruf pertama nama depan dan belakang).
     */
    public function inisial(): string
    {
        $nama = trim($this->full_name ?? '');
        $pecah = preg_split('/\s+/', $nama);

        if (count($pecah) === 1) {
            return strtoupper(mb_substr($nama, 0, 1));
        }

        return strtoupper(mb_substr($pecah[0], 0, 1).mb_substr(end($pecah), 0, 1));
    }
}

<?php

use App\Models\QualifixAnswer;
use App\Models\QualifixAttachment;
use App\Models\QualifixTicket;
use App\Models\StaffProfile;
use App\Models\Student;
use App\Models\Subject;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;

uses(RefreshDatabase::class);

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->siswaUser = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'siswa', 'status' => 'aktif']);
    $this->siswa = Student::create([
        'user_id' => $this->siswaUser->id,
        'full_name' => 'Aisyah Putri Azzahra',
        'nisn' => '0098123471',
        'status' => 'aktif',
    ]);

    $this->mapel = Subject::create(['code' => 'MTK', 'name' => 'Matematika Saintek']);

    $this->tentorUser = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'tentor', 'status' => 'aktif']);
    $this->tentor = StaffProfile::create([
        'user_id' => $this->tentorUser->id,
        'employee_number' => 'T001',
        'full_name_with_title' => 'Kak Hendra',
        'job_title' => 'Master Tentor Matematika',
        'status' => 'aktif',
    ]);

    // Tentor lain (bukan penugat) untuk uji otorisasi.
    $this->tentorLainUser = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'tentor', 'status' => 'aktif']);
    $this->tentorLain = StaffProfile::create([
        'user_id' => $this->tentorLainUser->id,
        'employee_number' => 'T002',
        'full_name_with_title' => 'Kak Rina',
        'job_title' => 'Master Tentor Fisika',
        'status' => 'aktif',
    ]);
});

test('siswa dapat mengajukan pertanyaan klinik pr dan tiket ditugaskan ke tentor', function () {
    $this->actingAs($this->siswaUser);

    $response = $this->post(route('siswa.qualifix.store'), [
        'subject_id' => $this->mapel->id,
        'title' => 'Barisan & Deret Geometri Tak Hingga',
        'question' => 'Kak Hendra, mohon bantuannya untuk soal nomor 6 deret geometri tak hingga.',
        'files' => [UploadedFile::fake()->image('pertanyaan.jpg')->size(100)],
    ]);

    $response->assertStatus(302);
    $response->assertSessionHas('sukses');

    $this->assertDatabaseHas('qualifix_tickets', [
        'student_id' => $this->siswa->id,
        'subject_id' => $this->mapel->id,
        'title' => 'Barisan & Deret Geometri Tak Hingga',
        'status' => 'menunggu_tentor',
    ]);

    $ticket = QualifixTicket::where('student_id', $this->siswa->id)->latest()->first();
    $this->assertNotNull($ticket->ticket_number);
    $this->assertStringStartsWith('KPR-', $ticket->ticket_number);
    $this->assertNotNull($ticket->submitted_at);

    // Tiket harus ditugaskan ke tentor aktif (fallback beban paling ringan).
    $this->assertDatabaseHas('qualifix_assignments', [
        'ticket_id' => $ticket->id,
        'staff_id' => $this->tentor->id,
    ]);

    // Lampiran tercatat.
    $this->assertDatabaseHas('qualifix_attachments', [
        'ticket_id' => $ticket->id,
        'answer_id' => null,
    ]);
});

test('siswa tanpa data siswa tidak boleh mengajukan', function () {
    $orangLain = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'siswa', 'status' => 'aktif']);
    // User ini tidak punya relasi Student.
    $this->actingAs($orangLain);

    $this->post(route('siswa.qualifix.store'), [
        'subject_id' => $this->mapel->id,
        'title' => 'Judul',
        'question' => 'Pertanyaan',
    ])->assertStatus(403);
});

test('tentor dapat menjawab pertanyaan yang ditugaskan kepadanya', function () {
    $ticket = QualifixTicket::create([
        'ticket_number' => 'KPR-TEST-001',
        'student_id' => $this->siswa->id,
        'subject_id' => $this->mapel->id,
        'title' => 'Uji Jawaban',
        'question' => 'Pertanyaan uji',
        'status' => 'menunggu_tentor',
        'submitted_at' => now(),
    ]);
    $ticket->staff()->attach($this->tentor->id);

    $this->actingAs($this->tentorUser);

    $response = $this->post(route('tentor.qualifix.answer', $ticket->id), [
        'body' => 'Ini adalah jawaban lengkap dari tentor.',
        'files' => [UploadedFile::fake()->image('jawaban.jpg')->size(100)],
    ]);

    $response->assertStatus(302);
    $response->assertSessionHas('sukses');

    $this->assertDatabaseHas('qualifix_answers', [
        'ticket_id' => $ticket->id,
        'staff_id' => $this->tentor->id,
        'body' => 'Ini adalah jawaban lengkap dari tentor.',
        'status' => 'terkirim',
    ]);

    // Status tiket berubah menjadi sedang_dibahas setelah dijawab.
    $this->assertDatabaseHas('qualifix_tickets', [
        'id' => $ticket->id,
        'status' => 'sedang_dibahas',
    ]);

    $this->assertDatabaseHas('qualifix_attachments', [
        'ticket_id' => $ticket->id,
        'answer_id' => QualifixAnswer::where('ticket_id', $ticket->id)->value('id'),
    ]);
});

test('tentor tidak boleh menjawab tiket yang bukan ditugaskan kepadanya', function () {
    $ticket = QualifixTicket::create([
        'ticket_number' => 'KPR-TEST-002',
        'student_id' => $this->siswa->id,
        'subject_id' => $this->mapel->id,
        'title' = > 'Uji Otorisasi',
        'question' => 'Pertanyaan',
        'status' => 'menunggu_tentor',
    ]);
    $ticket->staff()->attach($this->tentorLain->id);

    $this->actingAs($this->tentorUser);

    $this->post(route('tentor.qualifix.answer', $ticket->id), [
        'body' => 'Jawaban tidak sah.',
    ])->assertStatus(403);
});

test('tentor dapat menandai tiket selesai', function () {
    $ticket = QualifixTicket::create([
        'ticket_number' => 'KPR-TEST-003',
        'student_id' => $this->siswa->id,
        'subject_id' => $this->mapel->id,
        'title' => 'Uji Selesai',
        'question' => 'Pertanyaan',
        'status' => 'sedang_dibahas',
        'submitted_at' => now(),
    ]);
    $ticket->staff()->attach($this->tentor->id);

    $this->actingAs($this->tentorUser);

    $this->patch(route('tentor.qualifix.resolve', $ticket->id))
        ->assertStatus(302)
        ->assertSessionHas('sukses');

    $this->assertDatabaseHas('qualifix_tickets', [
        'id' => $ticket->id,
        'status' => 'selesai',
    ]);
    $this->assertNotNull($ticket->fresh()->resolved_at);
});

test('admin dapat menugaskan tentor ke tiket', function () {
    $admin = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'admin', 'status' => 'aktif']);
    $this->actingAs($admin);

    $ticket = QualifixTicket::create([
        'ticket_number' => 'KPR-TEST-004',
        'student_id' => $this->siswa->id,
        'subject_id' => $this->mapel->id,
        'title' => 'Uji Tugaskan',
        'question' => 'Pertanyaan',
        'status' => 'menunggu_tentor',
    ]);

    $this->post(route('admin.qualifix.assign', $ticket->id), [
        'staff_id' => $this->tentor->id,
    ])->assertStatus(302)->assertSessionHas('sukses');

    $this->assertDatabaseHas('qualifix_assignments', [
        'ticket_id' => $ticket->id,
        'staff_id' => $this->tentor->id,
    ]);
});

test('admin dapat mengubah status tiket', function () {
    $admin = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'admin', 'status' => 'aktif']);
    $this->actingAs($admin);

    $ticket = QualifixTicket::create([
        'ticket_number' => 'KPR-TEST-005',
        'student_id' => $this->siswa->id,
        'subject_id' => $this->mapel->id,
        'title' => 'Uji Status',
        'question' => 'Pertanyaan',
        'status' => 'menunggu_tentor',
    ]);

    $this->patch(route('admin.qualifix.status', $ticket->id), [
        'status' => 'selesai',
    ])->assertStatus(302)->assertSessionHas('sukses');

    $this->assertDatabaseHas('qualifix_tickets', [
        'id' => $ticket->id,
        'status' => 'selesai',
    ]);
    $this->assertNotNull($ticket->fresh()->resolved_at);
});

test('nomor tiket unik dan berurutan per bulan', function () {
    $this->actingAs($this->siswaUser);

    $this->post(route('siswa.qualifix.store'), [
        'subject_id' => $this->mapel->id,
        'title' => 'Tiket Pertama',
        'question' => 'Pertanyaan pertama',
    ]);

    $this->post(route('siswa.qualifix.store'), [
        'subject_id' => $this->mapel->id,
        'title' => 'Tiket Kedua',
        'question' => 'Pertanyaan kedua',
    ]);

    $tiket1 = QualifixTicket::where('title', 'Tiket Pertama')->value('ticket_number');
    $tiket2 = QualifixTicket::where('title', 'Tiket Kedua')->value('ticket_number');

    $this->assertNotNull($tiket1);
    $this->assertNotNull($tiket2);
    $this->assertNotSame($tiket1, $tiket2);

<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Models\Announcement;
use App\Models\ClassSession;
use App\Models\File;
use App\Models\Material;
use App\Models\QualifixTicket;
use App\Models\Student;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;

class SiswaDashboardDemoSeeder extends Seeder
{
    /**
     * Isi data contoh agar seluruh bagian dashboard siswa punya isi.
     */
    public function run(): void
    {
        $user = User::query()->where('role', 'siswa')->where('status', 'aktif')->orderBy('id')->first();

        if ($user === null) {
            $this->command->warn('Tidak ada akun siswa aktif. Jalankan RoleSeeder lebih dulu.');

            return;
        }

        $student = $user->student ?? Student::query()->whereNull('user_id')->orderBy('id')->first();

        if ($student === null) {
            $this->command->warn('Tidak ada data siswa untuk dihubungkan ke akun '.$user->email.'.');

            return;
        }

        if ($student->user_id === null) {
            $student->update(['user_id' => $user->id]);
        }

        if ($student->nickname === null) {
            $student->update(['nickname' => str($student->full_name)->explode(' ')->first()]);
        }

Sebelumnya halaman Klinik PR hanya tampilan kosong (read-only, tabel `qualifik_tickets` nol baris, tidak ada satu pun route tulis, modal ajukan masih mock UI). Sekarang alurnya sudah nyala:

**Alur:** Siswa ajukan → tiket masuk antrean & otomatis ditugaskan tentor → tentor jawab → ditandai selesai → terlihat di admin & dashboard.

### File baru
| File | Fungsi |
|---|---|
| `app/Services/QualifikService.php` | Logika bisnis: buat tiket, generate nomor `KPR-YYYYMM-####` (unik per bulan), auto-assign tentor lewat `schedule_rules` (mapel+kelas, fallback beban paling ringan), jawab, selesai, re-assign, ubah status |
| `app/Models/QualifikAnswer.php` | Model jawaban tentor (`qualifik_answers`) |
| `app/Models/QualifikAttachment.php` | Model lampiran (`qualifik_attachments`) |
| `app/Http/Requests/StoreQualifikTicketRequest.php` | Validasi ajukan tiket siswa (mapel, judul, isi, maks 2 file ≤2MB) |
| `app/Http/Requests/StoreQualifikAnswerRequest.php` | Validasi jawaban tentor |
| `tests/Feature/KlinikPrAlurTest.php` | 8 uji alur lengkap + otorisasi |

### File diubah
- `routes/web.php` — 5 route baru: `siswa.qualifik.store`, `tentor.qualifik.answer`, `tentor.qualifik.resolve`, `admin.qualifik.assign`, `admin.qualifik.status`
- `app/Http/Controllers/Student/StudentController.php` — `storeQualifik()`, fix bug KPI "Sudah Dijawab" (`dijawab` → `sedang_dibahas`), kirim `$subjects` ke view
- `app/Http/Controllers/Tentor/TentorQualifikController.php` — `answer()` + `resolve()` dengan cek kepemilikan tiket (403 kalau bukan tanggung jawabnya)
- `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/QualifikController.php` — `assign()` + `updateStatus()`
- `app/Services/TentorQualifikService.php` — `kartuAntrean()` sekarang sertakan ID tiket untuk membangun form
- `resources/views/siswa/qualifik.blade.php` — modal ajukan sekarang bentuk `<form>` sungguhan + `<x-flash-toast />`
- `resources/views/components/qualifik-ajukan-modal.blade.php` — form asli (mapel dari DB, input file, submit ke backend)
- `resources/views/tentor/qualifik.blade.php` — form jawaban (POST), tombol "Tandai Selesai" (PATCH), flash toast
- `resources/views/admin/qualifik.blade.php` — tombol "Tugaskan Tentor" (form dengan dropdown staff) & "Lihat Detail/Selasi" (form ubah status), flash toast
- `database/seeders/SiswaDashboardDemoSeeder.php` — tiket demo sekarang ditugaskan ke tentor + contoh jawaban agar panel admin/tentor tidak kosong

## Hasil uji
- 19 tes terkait Qualifik/Klinik PR: **19 lulus** (11 lama + 8 baru), 81 assertions
- `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` sudah dijalankan (format rapi)
- Semua file PHP lolos `php -l`
